subject: general
question: If the area of the base of a cone is 154 cm² and the area of the curved surface is 550 cm², then its volume is: ( {Take pi = frac{{22}}{7} } )
solution:
**Given**

Area of base of cone = 154 cm²

Area of curved surface = 550 cm²

**Formula used**

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr2h

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

where l is slant height

l = √h² + r²

**Calculation**

Area of base of cone = πr²

(22/7) × r² = 154

⇒ r² = (154 × 7)/22

⇒ r² = 1078/22

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = 7 cm

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

550 = (22/7) × 7 × l

⇒ 550/22 = l

⇒ 25 = l

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

h = √l² - r²

⇒ h = √(25)² - (7)²

⇒ h = √625 - 49

⇒ h = √576

⇒ h = 24

Volume of cone = (1/3) × (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 24

⇒ 22 × 7 × 8

⇒ 22 × 56

⇒ 1232 cm³

**∴ Volume of cone is 1232 cm³**
